title: BusinessObject
description: A real-world entity of interest to the business (e.g. Customer, Order, Product, Invoice, Feature Flag). Business Objects are the atoms that populate the ECF (Enterprise Concept Framework) matrix cells — every (domain, stage) cell contains the business objects currently in that lifecycle state. Ownership and stakeholders are referenced from typed catalogs. Catalog: technehub-labs/dea-catalog-business-objects.

object_class.description: Free-form class label for the kind of object (customer | order | product | invoice | feature-flag | grant | …). Together with object_subclass it forms a 2-axis classifier; the metamodel does not constrain the outer taxonomy because new object kinds emerge continuously.

object_subclass.description: Optional refinement under object_class (retail-customer | enterprise-order | …). Free-form.

ecf_domain.description: The Enterprise Concept Framework domain that this object primarily belongs to. Axiom-derived — see technehub-labs/dea-metaframework REPORT.md §2.

ecf_stage.description: The current lifecycle stage of this object. Per the ECF matrix, each (domain, stage) cell contains the business objects in that state.

current_state.description: Free-form business state label (active | proposed | provisioned | suspended | archived | …). Distinct from ecf_stage: current_state is a domain-specific business label, ecf_stage is the universal lifecycle coordinate.

state_history.description: Ordered list of state transitions with timestamps. Each entry may also record which ecf_stage the transition moved through.

identity.description: Identity attributes. primary_id is the canonical handle; external_ids map to source-system identifiers.

owner.description: Reference to an Actor entry in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-actors that owns this object. DEPRECATED (CR-002, CR-2F): relationship state is authoritative in the canonical relationship registry (metamodel/registry/relationships.yaml), not in entity schemas. This convenience property will be physically removed in CR-003.

stakeholders.description: References to entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-stakeholders. Multi-valued — an object may have several stakeholders (e.g. a customer is also a data subject).

capabilities_consumed.description: References to Business Capabilities in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-business-capabilities that act on this object.

processes_involved.description: References to Processes in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-processes that create, read, update, or delete this object.

events.description: References to business events in which this object participates (dea:event-customer-signed-up, etc.).

data_entities.description: References to data entities (dea:data-entity-customer-record) that persist this object.

components_realizing.description: References to Solution Components in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-digital-business-service-factory that realize this object.
